package io.github.xyz1001.pdsync.android;
import java.util.*;
import java.io.IOException;

class MainActivity {
    enum SyncPage { HOME, SETTINGS }
    enum OnboardingProgress { COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE }
    static class SecureConnectionStore { static class Connection { String endpoint="endpoint", username="user", profile="profile"; } }
    static class SyncRuntime {
        static SecureConnectionStore.Connection account; static String selection = "game-a", namespace = "scope-a";
        static SecureConnectionStore.Connection currentConnection() { return account; }
        static String currentSelectionToken(MainActivity a) { return selection; }
        static String currentNamespace(MainActivity a) { return namespace; }
        static long generation=1;
        static long connectionGeneration() { return generation; }
        static AndroidSyncFacade localFacade(MainActivity a, SecureConnectionStore.Connection c) { return new AndroidSyncFacade(); }
        static void clearOfficialSyncAccess(AndroidSyncFacade f) { f.authorized=false; }
        static void requireOfficialSyncAccess(Object context, SecureConnectionStore.Connection c, AndroidSyncFacade f) throws IOException { if(f.denied || f.expired) throw new IOException("access denied"); f.authorized=true; f.refreshes++; }
        static void checkOfficialSyncAccess(SecureConnectionStore.Connection c, AndroidSyncFacade f) throws IOException { f.gate(); }
    }
    static class AutoSyncStatusPolicy { static class Record {} }
    static class AutoSyncService {
        static AutoSyncStatusPolicy.Record beginManualInspection(MainActivity a) { return new AutoSyncStatusPolicy.Record(); }
        static void verifiedManualInspection(MainActivity a, AutoSyncStatusPolicy.Record record, AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection inspection) { a.verified++; }
    }
    static class Snapshot { String getId() { return "snapshot-a"; } }
    static class AppendCommit { Snapshot getSnapshot() { return new Snapshot(); } }
    static class SyncHistory {
        List<AppendCommit> cloud = new ArrayList<>();
        Map<String,String> aliases = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String,String> getAliases() { return aliases; }
        String current="current", currentId="latest";
        String getCurrentName() { return current; }
        List<AppendCommit> getCloud() { return cloud; }
        String getDefaultSnapshot() { return cloud.isEmpty() ? null : "snapshot-a"; }
    }
    interface Hook { void run() throws Exception; }
    static class AndroidSyncFacade {
        static class Inspection { String kind = "BOTH_EMPTY"; String getKind() { return kind; } boolean getNeedsRestoreRecovery() { return false; } boolean objectVerified = true; boolean isObjectVerified() { return objectVerified; } }
        Inspection observed = new Inspection(); SyncHistory history = new SyncHistory(); Hook hook = () -> {}, historyHook = () -> {}; int reads;
        boolean authorized, denied, expired, currentMatches=true, changeDuringPut; int refreshes, puts, readChecks;
        void gate() throws IOException { if(!authorized || expired) throw new IOException("WebDAV access denied"); }
        Inspection inspect() throws Exception { gate(); readChecks++; reads++; hook.run(); return observed; }
        Inspection inspectHome() throws Exception { return inspect(); }
        Map<String,String> remote = new LinkedHashMap<>(); boolean failRename; int fullReads;
        void renameHistory(Inspection inspection, String id, String name) throws Exception {
            gate();
            if (failRename) throw new java.io.IOException("PUT failed");
            puts++; remote.put(id, name); if(changeDuringPut) SyncRuntime.generation++;
        }
        void renameCurrent(Inspection inspection, String name) throws Exception { if(currentMatches) renameHistory(inspection,"latest",name); }
        void recoverRestore() { }
        Inspection inspectHomeHistory() throws Exception {
            fullReads++; Inspection result = inspect(); history.aliases = new LinkedHashMap<>(remote); return result;
        }
        Hook closeHook = () -> {};
        AutoCloseable beginHomeReadIdentityScope() { return () -> closeHook.run(); }
        SyncHistory historyPresentation(Inspection inspection) throws Exception { historyHook.run(); return history; }
    }
    static class SyncInspectionDiagnostics {
        enum Stage { RUNTIME, INSPECT, HISTORY }
        static Exception at(Stage stage, Exception error) { return error; }
    }
    static class InstallDiagnostics { static Object find(Exception error) { return null; } }
    static class PreparationDiagnostics { static Object find(Exception error) { return null; } }
    static class BridgeDiagnostics { static Object find(Exception error) { return null; } }
    enum DiagnosticStage { VERIFY }
    enum DiagnosticFailure { RECOVERY_REQUIRED, NONE }
    static class DiagnosticLog { static void record(Object... arguments) {} }
    static class AndroidDiagnosticLogging { static Object inspectionResult(String kind, boolean failed) { return null; } }
    static class StaleArchiveReadException extends Exception { }
    final HomeArchiveReadState archiveReads = new HomeArchiveReadState();
    SecureConnectionStore.Connection connection = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection();
    OnboardingProgress progress = OnboardingProgress.COMPLETE;
    SyncPage page = SyncPage.HOME; boolean destroyed, cloudVerified, resumed = true, sharedAppreciationOnly; int published, verified, namespacePreparations;
    AndroidSyncFacade facade = new AndroidSyncFacade(); AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection inspection;
    SyncHistory history; Object homeObservationOwner; String selected, explicitHomeSelection;
    static class HomeActionContext {
        final Object account, facade, inspection, history; final String scope;
        HomeActionContext(MainActivity a) { account=a.connection; facade=a.facade; inspection=a.inspection; history=a.history; scope=SyncRuntime.selection+SyncRuntime.namespace; }
        boolean accepts(HomeActionContext other, boolean page, boolean busy) { return page && !busy && other!=null && account==other.account && facade==other.facade && inspection==other.inspection && history==other.history && scope.equals(other.scope); }
    }
    static class HistoryNamePresentation {
        static String sanitize(String s) { return s; }
        static String currentCloudId(SyncHistory h) { return h.currentId; }
        static SyncHistory display(SyncHistory h, Map<String,String> aliases, String current) {
            SyncHistory copy=new SyncHistory(); copy.aliases.putAll(h.aliases); copy.aliases.putAll(aliases); copy.current=current==null?h.current:current; copy.currentId=h.currentId; return copy;
        }
    }
    static class Text { String text() { return "notice"; } }
    static final Text SAVED_ON_THIS_DEVICE_PUBLISHED_HISTORY_266 = new Text(), SAVES_HAVE_CHANGED_PLEASE_RENAME_AGAIN_267 = new Text(), SAVING_NAME_268 = new Text(), NAME_SAVED_269 = new Text(), SET_UP_THE_CLOUD_CONNECTION_FIRST_143 = new Text(), THE_CONNECTION_HAS_CHANGED_COMPARE_AGAIN_158 = new Text();
    enum DiagnosticAction { CONFIGURE }
    interface Task<T> { T run() throws Exception; }
    interface Done<T> { void accept(T value) throws Exception; }
    static class Naming { java.util.function.Consumer<String> save; String initial; void open(String id, String initial, String label, java.util.function.Consumer<String> save, Runnable cancel) { this.save = save; this.initial=initial; } }
    Naming homeNaming = new Naming(); int sharedHomeRenderToken; String notice; Exception workFailure;
    HomeActionContext currentHomeContext(int token) { return new HomeActionContext(this); }
    boolean isCurrentHomeAction(HomeActionContext owner) { return true; }
    void render() {} void refreshComparison(SyncPage page) {} void chooseRunIdentity() {}
    final ThreadLocal<OfficialOperationLease> officialOperationLease = new ThreadLocal<>();
    Object getApplicationContext() { return this; }
    static class AndroidHomeDialogComposition { static void showNaming(MainActivity a, int token, String initial, String label, java.util.function.Consumer<String> save, Runnable cancel) { a.homeNaming.save=save; } }
    boolean defer; Runnable pending;
    <T> void work(DiagnosticAction action, String message, Task<T> task, Done<T> done) {
        workFailure=null;
        pending=() -> {
            try {
                T result;
                try (OfficialOperationLease lease = new OfficialOperationLease()) {
                    officialOperationLease.set(lease);
                    try { result=task.run(); } finally { officialOperationLease.remove(); }
                }
                done.accept(result);
            } catch (Exception failure) { workFailure = failure; }
        };
        if(!defer) pending.run();
    }
    MainActivity() { SyncRuntime.account = connection; SyncRuntime.selection = "game-a"; SyncRuntime.namespace = "scope-a"; }
    boolean isDestroyed() { return destroyed; }
    boolean isForegroundHome() { return resumed && !destroyed && page == SyncPage.HOME && !sharedAppreciationOnly; }
    void publishArchiveReadState() { published++; }
    Object diagnosticInspectionDetails(AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection inspection) { return null; }
    void prepareOfficialHomeNamespace(AndroidSyncFacade facade) { namespacePreparations++; }
    void invalidatePreparedOfficialNamespace() { }
    /* PRODUCTION_METHODS */
    static void check(boolean condition, String message) { if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message); }
    static void terminal(MainActivity a) { check(!a.archiveReads.loading(), "terminal read left loading active"); check(a.published == 2, "start and terminal state must publish"); }
    static void stale(HookWithOwner change) throws Exception {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.facade.hook = () -> change.run(a);
        try { a.readComparison(); throw new AssertionError("stale read accepted"); } catch (StaleArchiveReadException expected) {}
        check(a.history == null && a.inspection == null && !a.cloudVerified && a.verified == 0, "stale result polluted new scope");
        if (!a.archiveReads.loading()) terminal(a); // An overlapping newer read retains its own loading state.
    }
    interface HookWithOwner { void run(MainActivity a) throws Exception; }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        MainActivity empty = new MainActivity(); empty.readComparison(); terminal(empty);
        check(empty.namespacePreparations == 1, "ordinary read preserves namespace preparation");
        MainActivity renewed = new MainActivity(); renewed.readComparison(false); terminal(renewed);
        check(renewed.namespacePreparations == 0 && renewed.facade.reads == 1 && renewed.cloudVerified, "renewal read must remain read-only");
        for (int state = 0; state < 2; state++) for (int outcome = 0; outcome < 4; outcome++) {
            MainActivity hidden = new MainActivity(); final int condition = state, result = outcome;
            if (result == 1) hidden.facade.observed.kind = "BLOCKED";
            Hook departure = () -> {
                if (condition == 0) hidden.resumed = false; else hidden.sharedAppreciationOnly = true;
                if (result == 2) throw new java.io.IOException("offline while leaving HOME");
            };
            if (result == 3) hidden.facade.historyHook = departure; else hidden.facade.hook = departure;
            try { hidden.readComparison(false); throw new AssertionError("hidden renewal result accepted"); }
            catch (StaleArchiveReadException expected) {}
            terminal(hidden);
            check(hidden.namespacePreparations == 0 && hidden.history == null && hidden.inspection == null
                    && !hidden.cloudVerified && hidden.verified == 0, "hidden renewal success, blocked, or error polluted HOME");
        }
        check(empty.history != null && empty.history.cloud.isEmpty() && empty.cloudVerified && empty.verified == 1, "confirmed empty must be verified, not null");
        MainActivity success = new MainActivity(); success.facade.history.cloud.add(new AppendCommit()); success.readComparison(); terminal(success);
        check(success.history == success.facade.history && success.facade.reads == 1 && "snapshot-a".equals(success.selected), "successful history read");
        MainActivity blocked = new MainActivity(); blocked.facade.observed.kind = "BLOCKED"; blocked.readComparison(); terminal(blocked);
        check(blocked.history == null && !blocked.cloudVerified && blocked.inspection != null && blocked.verified == 0, "blocked is unknown, not empty");
        for (Exception failure : List.of(new java.io.IOException("offline"), new InterruptedException("cancelled"))) {
            MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.facade.hook = () -> { throw failure; };
            try { a.readComparison(); throw new AssertionError("failure swallowed"); } catch (Exception actual) { check(actual == failure, "failure identity"); }
            terminal(a); check(a.history == null && !a.cloudVerified && a.verified == 0, "failure authorized actions");
        }
        stale(a -> a.connection = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection());
        stale(a -> SyncRuntime.account = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection());
        stale(a -> SyncRuntime.selection = "game-b");
        stale(a -> SyncRuntime.namespace = "scope-b");
        stale(a -> a.page = SyncPage.SETTINGS);
        stale(a -> { a.destroyed = true; a.archiveReads.close(); });
        stale(a -> a.archiveReads.invalidate());
        stale(a -> a.archiveReads.begin());
        // Reconstructed code92: close is an authentication fence, including blocked observations.
        for (String kind : List.of("BOTH_EMPTY", "BLOCKED")) {
            MainActivity a = new MainActivity(); a.facade.observed.kind = kind;
            java.io.IOException closeFailure = new java.io.IOException("installed identity changed");
            a.facade.closeHook = () -> {
                check(a.history == null && a.inspection == null && !a.cloudVerified && a.homeObservationOwner == null,
                        "observation was published before identity close");
                throw closeFailure;
            };
            try { a.readComparison(); throw new AssertionError("identity close failure swallowed"); }
            catch (java.io.IOException actual) { check(actual == closeFailure, "close failure identity"); }
            terminal(a);
            check(a.history == null && a.inspection == null && !a.cloudVerified && a.homeObservationOwner == null && a.verified == 0,
                    "failed identity close authorized HOME");
        }
        MainActivity preview = new MainActivity(); preview.facade.observed.objectVerified = false;
        preview.readComparison(); terminal(preview);
        check(preview.history != null && preview.cloudVerified && preview.verified == 0,
                "metadata observation acknowledged a fully verified automatic failure");
        MainActivity action = new MainActivity(); action.facade.closeHook = () -> { throw new AssertionError("full action used HOME scope"); };
        action.readComparison(true, false); terminal(action);
        check(action.verified == 1, "post-action full read lost verification");
        MainActivity rename = new MainActivity();
        rename.facade.remote.put("ancestor", "old ancestor"); rename.facade.remote.put("latest", "old latest");
        rename.inspection = rename.facade.observed; rename.history = rename.facade.history;
        rename.history.aliases.putAll(rename.facade.remote); rename.defer=true;
        rename.rename("ancestor"); rename.homeNaming.save.accept("new ancestor");
        check("new ancestor".equals(rename.displayHomeHistory().aliases.get("ancestor")) && rename.facade.puts==0 && "old ancestor".equals(rename.history.aliases.get("ancestor")), "optimistic name must precede PUT without mutating evidence");
        rename.pending.run();
        check(rename.workFailure == null && rename.facade.puts == 1 && rename.facade.refreshes == 1 && rename.facade.readChecks == 0 && !rename.facade.authorized, "PUT must revoke authorization without readback");
        rename.rename("ancestor"); check("new ancestor".equals(rename.homeNaming.initial), "reopened editor must see displayed name");
        rename.rename("latest"); rename.homeNaming.save.accept("new latest");
        rename.pending.run();
        check("new ancestor".equals(rename.displayHomeHistory().aliases.get("ancestor")) && "new latest".equals(rename.displayHomeHistory().aliases.get("latest")), "successive overlays must accumulate");
        rename.facade.failRename = true; rename.notice = null;
        rename.rename("ancestor"); rename.homeNaming.save.accept("failed");
        rename.pending.run();
        check(rename.workFailure != null && rename.notice == null && rename.facade.readChecks == 0 && "new ancestor".equals(rename.displayHomeHistory().aliases.get("ancestor")) && "new latest".equals(rename.displayHomeHistory().aliases.get("latest")), "failed PUT must roll back only its name");
        check(!rename.facade.authorized, "failed PUT must revoke authorization");
        rename.history=new SyncHistory(); rename.history.aliases.put("ancestor","remote change");
        check("remote change".equals(rename.displayHomeHistory().aliases.get("ancestor")), "new observation must discard overlays");
        MainActivity staleRename = new MainActivity(); staleRename.inspection=staleRename.facade.observed; staleRename.history=staleRename.facade.history; staleRename.defer=true;
        staleRename.rename("ancestor"); staleRename.homeNaming.save.accept("pending");
        staleRename.history=new SyncHistory(); staleRename.history.aliases.put("ancestor","new page"); staleRename.facade.failRename=true; staleRename.pending.run();
        check(staleRename.facade.puts==0 && staleRename.workFailure==null && "new page".equals(staleRename.displayHomeHistory().aliases.get("ancestor")), "stale queued work must not overwrite new observation");
        for (boolean dialog : new boolean[]{false,true}) for (boolean match : new boolean[]{false,true}) {
            MainActivity current = new MainActivity(); current.inspection=current.facade.observed; current.history=current.facade.history; current.history.currentId=match?"latest":null; current.cloudVerified=true; current.facade.currentMatches=match;
            if(dialog) current.editCurrent(); else current.renameCurrentInline(); current.homeNaming.save.accept("current name");
            check(current.workFailure == null && current.facade.puts == (match ? 1 : 0) && current.facade.readChecks == 0 && current.facade.refreshes == 1 && !current.facade.authorized && "current name".equals(current.displayHomeHistory().current) && (match == current.displayHomeHistory().aliases.containsKey("latest")), "current rename authorization or matching branch");
        }
        for (int failure=0; failure<3; failure++) {
            MainActivity denied = new MainActivity(); denied.inspection=denied.facade.observed; denied.history=denied.facade.history;
            if(failure==0) denied.facade.denied=true; if(failure==1) denied.facade.expired=true; if(failure==2) SyncRuntime.account=new SecureConnectionStore.Connection();
            denied.rename("ancestor"); denied.homeNaming.save.accept("blocked");
            check((failure == 2 || denied.workFailure != null) && denied.facade.puts == 0 && !denied.facade.authorized, "denied/expired/changed binding must not PUT");
        }
        MainActivity changed = new MainActivity(); changed.inspection=changed.facade.observed; changed.history=changed.facade.history; changed.facade.changeDuringPut=true;
        changed.rename("ancestor"); changed.homeNaming.save.accept("changed");
        check(changed.facade.puts == 1 && changed.facade.readChecks == 0 && !changed.facade.authorized && changed.displayHomeHistory() == changed.history, "binding change after PUT must not publish stale result");
        MainActivity recovery = new MainActivity();
        recovery.work(DiagnosticAction.CONFIGURE, "", () -> { recovery.sync(); recovery.localSync().recoverRestore(); return null; }, result -> {});
        check(recovery.workFailure == null && !recovery.facade.authorized && recovery.facade.puts == 0 && recovery.facade.readChecks == 0, "local recovery must revoke access without network I/O");
        System.out.println("History read terminal and stale-scope checks passed");
    }
}
